Must be a constant expression. b Radix point position of the second fixed point operand. Must be a constant expression. c Radix point position of the fixed point result. Must be a constant expre s- sion. Valid range: 0 <= |a - b| <= 31 (c - b) <= 31, (a - c) <= 31, a >= b (c - a) <= 31, (b - c) <= 31, a < b Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value <Out Type> a >= b: 2^(c - a) * [x + (y * 2^(a - b))], a < b: 2^(c - b) * [(x * 2^(b - a)) + y] Description The routine adds two 32 - bit integers with scaling factors set by input parameters. Available via Mfx.h
